decisions.statement: An element no selector finds is refused rather than tapped at nowhere.
A call names either an element or a point.
An element and a point named together are refused rather than chosen between.
A point is an across and a down.
A tap is native rather than a click in the page.
A refusal names the context switch attaching to the webview already made.
A tap is named as sent before that tap goes out.
A run that threw on the send names that send in its refusal.
The session, the finding, the clicking and the pointing are handed in.

definition: the command tapping the simulator screen the way a finger would
